We Fix Hacked Website Today

Hacked Website Repair in Chicago, IL — Same-Day Malware Cleanup & WordPress Fixes

A hacked website can disrupt your entire business — especially in a fast-moving city like Chicago. Pages stop updating, the dashboard refuses to load, and unexpected redirects disturb your users. When this happens, you need immediate help — not a slow ticket system or generic support email.
At WevTEC, we provide same-day hacked website repair, advanced malware cleanup, secure code restoration, hosting reinstatement, and Google-warning removal for Chicago businesses of all sizes. With more than 12 years of experience repairing hundreds of infected websites nationwide, we understand both the urgency and complexity behind a full recovery. Your data is backed up securely, your site is cleaned properly, and your SEO visibility is protected with a guaranteed safe repair.
Our team fixes your website the same day, restores everything to full functionality, and charges only after your site is live and clean.

Fix My Hacked Website Now
Emergency Website Repair

When Chicago Websites Are Hacked — The Symptoms You’ll Notice First

Chicago clients often report issues slowly at first: a plugin won’t update, the dashboard loads halfway, or the site randomly freezes. These symptoms quickly evolve into obvious signs of infection.
 Some of the most common indicators include:

  • A surprising blank white screen known as the White Screen of Death
  • Dashboard login no longer accepting your credentials
  • Pages, products, or blog posts refusing to save
  • Sudden redirects to casino, adult, or spam websites
  • Pop-ups or aggressive ads appearing without being installed
  • Unknown administrators or users added without your permission
  • Themes and plugins disappearing or malfunctioning
  • Google displaying the warning: “This site may be hacked”
  • Hosting accounts suspended for “malware detected”
  • The site working on desktop but broken on mobile
  • Layouts shifting or collapsing unexpectedly

When any of these appear, your website is no longer safe — and deeper infections are often already present in your files or database. We identify and eliminate all malware, even the hidden components other developers overlook.

Restore My Website Today

Chicago Small Businesses Trust Us for Fast Website Recovery

Businesses in Chicago rely heavily on digital presence, whether it’s a law office in The Loop, a medical clinic in Hyde Park, a restaurant in West Loop, a boutique in Lincoln Park, or a contractor serving Logan Square and surrounding neighborhoods. When your website goes down, your customers can’t reach you — and Chicago’s competitive market doesn’t give you room for downtime.

Our approach is tailored for real Chicago business owners who need reliability, transparency, and speed. We analyze every infected file, restore your damaged code, clean malicious scripts, fix broken pages, recover access, and make sure your website is functioning normally within hours — not days.

Your business deserves a repair team that handles everything: malware cleanup, error fixing, hosting coordination, SEO recovery, and long-term security protection.

Make My Website Safe Again
Hacked Website? We Fix It Same Day.

Deep Website Recovery & Google Warning Removal — Chicago Professionals Rely on It

Most website hacks go far beyond the surface. In Chicago, we frequently find infections inside the hosting account, database, or even at the server-level. These intrusions damage a website’s ability to save changes, update themes, or function on mobile. They also create spammy URLs in Google, which can hurt your reputation instantly.

We perform a complete multi-layer recovery, including:

  • Removing malicious scripts and injected code
  • Fixing broken file permissions
  • Cleaning corrupted WordPress or PHP core
  • Removing malicious cron jobs
  • Correcting hacked htaccess rules
  • Securing the server environment
  • Removing spam URLs created by the hacker
  • Cleaning hidden malware inside themes and plugins

If Google marks your site with warnings such as:

“This site may be hacked”
 “Dangerous site ahead”

We remove all infected content, request a Google Security Review, and help restore your lost rankings. Most Chicago websites see their Google warnings removed within 24–72 hours after cleanup.

Scan & Repair My Website

If your website gets hacked more than once, it means there is an unresolved vulnerability. Chicago business owners often experience repeat infections due to compromised plugins, weak hosting, outdated themes, or an exploited password. We specialize in identifying the root cause and eliminating it completely. Whether your business is located in The Loop, River North, West Loop, Lincoln Park, Hyde Park, Wicker Park, Logan Square, Lakeview, or South Loop, a compromised website instantly impacts visibility, customer trust, and revenue. 

Our security hardening includes detailed forensic investigation, repairing infected PHP files, restoring damaged directories, and implementing firewall rules. We also improve file structure, lock down exposed admin areas, secure your database, and redesign weak access configurations.

If your hosting provider — GoDaddy, Bluehost, SiteGround, HostGator, Cloudways, Namecheap, or A2 Hosting — suspended your account, we work with them directly to restore access quickly and safely.

Our ongoing security plans start at $300 per month, offering continuous monitoring, backups, malware scanning, and performance optimization to keep your Chicago website safe 24/7.

Fix Today, Perform Tomorrow

Why Chicago Businesses Prefer WevTEC

Chicago business owners appreciate the combination of skill, speed, and transparency we offer. Instead of leaving you guessing, we explain what caused the issue, how we fix it, and how we’ll protect you moving forward.

Chicago businesses know we fix websites the right way — clean, fast, and secure.
